title: MediaSound
description: One sound effect: a mono PCM16 WAV and the descriptor's fields (port-format §2.5).

$schema.description: path or URL of this schema

release.description: the release whose encoding this is

index.description: the sound's index in its release's table

file.description: the sound beside this file: WAV, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis or MP3 (decoded, mixed to mono and resampled to `rate` when building)

rate.description: the descriptor's sample rate in Hz; the file is resampled to it

loop.description: loop start in samples at `rate` (null: plays once); a loop in the file's tags (WAV smpl, LOOPSTART/LOOPLENGTH/LOOPEND) wins. PS2: a multiple of 28 (an ADPCM block)

samples.description: BLAKE2b-128 of the PCM16 LE samples (pairing.md `n` for GameCube and PC); PS2: of the decoded ADPCM without its silent first block

encoded.description: PS2: BLAKE2b-128 of the SPU-ADPCM bytes, reused while the WAV still has the samples above
